text: Men laatino e nguurndam amen aduna, meɗen rewaynoo Mo men toroo Mo daɗndugol men Yiite. Tawde pellet, ko Kanko woni moƴƴo goonguɗo e ko O fodi jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen kon, Hinnotooɗo ɓe. Hino jeyaa e ko O moƴƴorii e amen O yurmii men : fewnugol men e gomɗinal, naada men Aljanna, woɗɗina men e Yiite.
